resources.string: Inspect IMS APN candidates for this China Broadnet SIM. APN configuration is a useful next check when data works but IMS or calls do not.

The home PLMN could not be verified. Refresh the SIM and IMS state before checking again.
The target SIM changed or became unavailable. Refresh the SIM and IMS state before checking again.

This is a database snapshot of candidates, not proof of the active data profile, IMS registration, or call bearer. A matching entry may coexist with shared entries; verify the actual network result after any change.

China Broadnet reference: data APN cbnet; a separate IMS entry with APN ims and type ims; normal and roaming protocols IPV4V6. Preserve working data entries and the preferred APN. Record original values before editing in system settings.

Confirm %1$s in system settings before editing; the system may ignore the subscription parameter or hide IMS entries. After editing, check again and refresh IMS status. Network re-registration may be needed before calls recover.
The APN settings page could not be opened. Open Settings → Network & internet → SIMs → the target SIM → Access Point Names, if available.
